notes.text: Hyman gives Shabbat 53b. In the corresponding passage at [Shabbat 43b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.43b.7), Rav Chanina bar Shlamia speaks in the name of Rav. Berakhot gives the alternative Rav Yeimar bar Shizvi.
The Yerushalmi spells the scribe’s name Shilmaya (שילמיא).
